round_trip.description: Read back an edited rendering of a final version 2. Changes text and fields, adds a success signal with `new`, removes an example and the only non-goal, accepts a proposed risk by removing its status line, and edits copied material that the reader ignores. The result is draft version 3.
A glossary with a rejected term T3. The rendering leaves T3 out. The new term gets T4, because the T counter is 3. T3 stays in the next version, unchanged, at the end of the item list.

A draft version 3 that pins a glossary. The rendering copies the accepted glossary terms under "From other artifacts". The edit rejects C4 with a status line, adds a proposed requirement with an example, and removes the answer of Q2. The base is a draft, so the result keeps version 3 and its parents.

invalid.reason: S9 is not an item of the rendering. Use `- new:` to add an item.
G1 is a goal, but it is under Success signals.
colour is not a field of a goal.
verification is a field of a success signal, not of a goal.
Notes is not a section name.
T3 is rejected, so it is not in the rendering. A rejected item cannot come back through Markdown.
The front matter names a different artifact ID from the base version.
A critique needs evidence, and evidence is not in the Markdown. The result fails the schema.
